title: Preserve spatial safety before visual detail
description: Inject transport, tracking, and anchor incidents. The selected response must preserve trustworthy local pose and user control before optional rendering quality or shared continuity.

policies.label: Reduce streamed detail
policies.detail: Keep local pose and input while lowering bitrate, resolution, or remote scene complexity.

policies.label: Pause world-locked interaction
policies.detail: Stop placement-sensitive actions and expose a tracking recovery state.

policies.label: Quarantine conflicting anchor
policies.detail: Keep the last trusted local space and require reconciliation before sharing changes.

policies.label: Preserve full detail and interaction
policies.detail: Continue as if every dependency were healthy.

incidents.label: Remote frame jitter
incidents.detail: Local tracking is valid, but streamed frame delivery misses its expected cadence.
incidents.safeResult: Local pose remains responsive while streamed detail steps down.
incidents.unsafeResult: Late full-detail frames create uneven presentation while capacity remains saturated.

stages.label: Local tracking
stages.detail: Predicted poses remain available on device.

stages.label: XR compositor
stages.detail: Can preserve local pose only if late content is bounded.

incidents.label: Positional tracking lost
incidents.detail: The runtime cannot provide a trustworthy world-relative pose.
incidents.safeResult: World-locked interaction pauses and the user receives a recovery path.
incidents.unsafeResult: Content continues from an untrusted pose and can drift relative to the physical world.

stages.label: Safety UI
stages.detail: Recovery and manual exit remain available.

incidents.label: Shared anchor conflict
incidents.detail: A remote anchor update disagrees with the locally trusted mapping epoch.
incidents.safeResult: The conflicting update is isolated while the last trusted local space stays usable.
incidents.unsafeResult: The remote update moves shared content before clients agree on a reference frame.

stages.label: Local reference space
stages.detail: The current local mapping is still valid.

stages.label: Shared content
stages.detail: Must wait for reconciliation or relocalization.
